plugin_sdk_settings.url.description: Base URL of the InfluxDB server. For SQL, include the Flight SQL port if it differs from 443.

plugin_sdk_settings.timeout.description: Timeout in whole seconds for HTTP requests and for connecting to the secure SOCKS proxy.

plugin_sdk_settings.httpHeaders.description: Headers sent with HTTP requests. Store each name in jsonData.httpHeaderName<N> and its value in secureJsonData.httpHeaderValue<N>, starting at 1.

plugin_sdk_settings.tlsAuth.description: Present a client certificate on HTTP connections.

plugin_sdk_settings.tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Trust a custom certificate authority for TLS connections.

plugin_sdk_settings.tlsSkipVerify.description: Skip verification of the server certificate for HTTP requests.

plugin_sdk_settings.basicAuthUser.description: Username sent with HTTP basic authentication.

plugin_sdk_settings.basicAuthPassword.description: Password sent with HTTP basic authentication.

plugin_sdk_settings.tlsCACert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the server certificate.

plugin_sdk_settings.tlsClientCert.description: PEM-encoded client certificate sent to the HTTP server.

plugin_sdk_settings.tlsClientKey.description: PEM-encoded private key for the HTTP client certificate.

plugin_sdk_settings.serverName.description: Server name used to verify the certificate on HTTP connections.

plugin_sdk_settings.oauthPassThru.description: Forward the signed-in user’s OAuth identity on HTTP requests. For OAuth-only authentication, omit the database user and password.

fields.label: Access
fields.description: Send requests through the Grafana server.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: InfluxDB product used to select the available query languages. The editor can identify it from the URL or the server response.

fields.label: Query language

options.label: SQL
options.description: Native SQL language. Supported in InfluxDB 3.0

fields.description: Query language to use for this data source. Defaults to InfluxQL when omitted.

overrides.when: jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB Cloud Dedicated' || jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB Clustered' || jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB Enterprise 3.x' || jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB OSS 3.x'
jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB Enterprise 1.x' || jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB Cloud (TSM)' || jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB OSS 1.x' || jsonData_product == 'InfluxDB OSS 2.x'

fields.label: Authentication Method
fields.description: Select how Grafana authenticates HTTP requests. Database credentials are configured separately.

fields.label: Database
fields.description: Database to query with InfluxQL or Flight SQL. For InfluxQL on 2.x, use the database name in the DBRP mapping.

fields.label: User
fields.description: Database username for InfluxQL password authentication. It also enables HTTP Basic fallback when no OAuth token is forwarded. Omit it for OAuth-only or unauthenticated connections.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Password paired with the InfluxQL database user. Omit it for OAuth-only or unauthenticated connections.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: Organization required for every Flux connection, including InfluxDB 1.8. Flux queries also use it for the v.organization macro.

fields.label: Default Bucket
fields.description: Bucket used by the v.defaultBucket macro in Flux queries.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Flux API token, or username:password for Flux on 1.8. Flight SQL sends any nonempty token as a Bearer credential. Omit it when the SQL server has authentication disabled.

fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: HTTP method used for InfluxQL queries. POST carries the query in the request body.

fields.label: Autocomplete range
fields.description: Time range applied to InfluxQL tag autocomplete queries.

fields.label: Min time interval
fields.description: Lower limit for the automatic query interval, such as 10s.

fields.label: Max series
fields.description: Maximum number of series or tables returned by a Flux query. Use a whole number. Zero uses the default of 1000.

fields.label: Insecure Connection
fields.description: Use plaintext gRPC to connect to a Flight SQL server.

fields.label: Legacy database
fields.description: Fallback database name for existing configurations without jsonData.dbName.

fields.label: Secure SOCKS proxy
fields.description: Route connections through the secure SOCKS proxy configured on the Grafana server.

fields.label: SOCKS proxy username or PDC network
fields.description: SOCKS5 username. Defaults to the data source UID. For a Grafana Cloud PDC agent, use the ID of the private network selected from the networks in your stack.

fields.label: SOCKS proxy password
fields.description: SOCKS5 password if the proxy requires one. Omit it for a PDC agent network.

fields.label: PDC section
fields.description: Grafana sets this flag to show the Private Data Source Connect entry in the settings sidebar.

instructions.msg: Set type to influxdb and access to proxy. Use the InfluxDB server URL without a query endpoint. For the product-based editor, select jsonData.product and a supported jsonData.version. Existing provisioned data sources can omit product.

For InfluxQL, set jsonData.version to InfluxQL and jsonData.dbName to the database. For database password authentication use root user and secureJsonData.password. HTTP Basic uses basicAuth: true, basicAuthUser and secureJsonData.basicAuthPassword. For OAuth forwarding use jsonData.oauthPassThru: true. An InfluxQL server with authentication disabled needs no credentials.

For InfluxQL token authentication on InfluxDB 2.x, set jsonData.httpHeaderName1 to Authorization and secureJsonData.httpHeaderValue1 to "Token <token>". The token stored in secureJsonData.token is read only for Flux and SQL.

For Flux, set jsonData.version to Flux, jsonData.organization and jsonData.defaultBucket. Put the API token in secureJsonData.token. When connecting to the Flux API on 1.8, put "<user>:<password>" in this same secret.

For SQL, set jsonData.version to SQL and jsonData.dbName. Put the raw database token in secureJsonData.token. Flight SQL uses gRPC with TLS by default. It trusts the system roots and optionally secureJsonData.tlsCACert when jsonData.tlsAuthWithCACert is enabled. For a plaintext server set jsonData.insecureGrpc to true. Omit the token only when the server allows unauthenticated connections.

HTTP authentication, client certificates, server name, skip verification, and custom headers apply to HTTP queries. SQL constructs its own gRPC credentials from the database token and CA configuration.

When editor validation is enabled it requires a product and query language, a database user and password for InfluxQL, and a token for SQL. Provisioned configurations may instead use a header or forwarded identity for InfluxQL, or omit credentials on servers with authentication disabled.

A secure SOCKS proxy must be configured on the Grafana server. Set jsonData.enableSecureSocksProxy to true. For a Cloud PDC agent network, use the network ID in jsonData.secureSocksProxyUsername and omit the proxy password. For a SOCKS5 proxy with password authentication, use jsonData.secureSocksProxyUsername and secureJsonData.secureSocksProxyPassword. The InfluxDB URL must be reachable from the proxy.
